snippet.title: Cruise Control - Demo Out Now!
snippet.description:
All aboard! Cruise Control’s demo is out now on Steam!
Play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4790640/Cruise_Control_Demo/

Manage a cruise ship in this time-management strategy game! Build the dream cruise experience for your guests, work fast to solve problems, keep up with demand, upgrade your offerings to make every voyage even better, and keep the chaos from going overboard!

Cruise Control is coming to Steam in 2027!
